Definition: from Πυθώ (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located); a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying):-- divination.
BiblicalUsage: Python is the name behind the spirit of divination in the slave girl at Philippi, who brought her masters much gain by soothsaying. Paul commanded the spirit out of her in the name of Jesus Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the fortune-telling spirit was real, and that its expulsion is what landed Paul and Silas in prison, which tells me the gospel costs something when it takes away a livelihood.
